instruction: Please save the opened image to the desktop with the filename 'my_photo.jpg'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting the GIMP image to desktop with a different filename ('my_photo.jpg'). Evaluator uses custom functions to verify: (1) the file was saved to the correct location, and (2) the image structure matches the original file. Custom getter downloads both result and reference files for comparison.

Metric logic is semantically correct: checks file existence first, then uses SSIM (Structural Similarity Index) to verify image structure matches reference
Complete coverage: instruction requires saving with specific filename to specific location, evaluator checks both aspects plus content correctness
Robust edge case handling: handles missing files, download failures, image size mismatches, and SSIM computation errors
